_kat_input.$comment: Real P-256-signed envelope (RFC-AITP-0001 §5.4). The envelope is exactly env-005's input envelope with its __VALID_ENVELOPE_SIG__ placeholder replaced by a committed signature; scripts/verify-known-answer.mjs asserts the two agree member for member apart from `signature`. sig_input is message_id|timestamp|sender.agent_id|hex(sha256(JCS(payload))); d = sha256(sig_input); the p256 signature is ECDSA with e = d (§5.4.6), RFC 6979 deterministic k, low-S (§5.4.7).

_must_not_verify.$comment: ECDSA over sha256(d) instead of d: what a signer that hashes the digest again emits. It MUST NOT verify over sig_input.
